summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of AFC Cross-Border Treasury and Settlement System 20-slide animated presentation. All features working correctly: public route /proposals/afc-treasury loads without authentication, all 20 slides render with data-testid afc-slide-1 through afc-slide-20, navigation (ArrowRight/ArrowLeft keys + prev/next buttons) works correctly, slide counter shows '01 / 20' format in JetBrains Mono font, progress bar at top updates proportionally (5% at slide 1, 50% at slide 10), Escape key opens grid overlay with 20 thumbnail slots, clicking thumbnails navigates to slides. Key slides verified: Slide 1 (title with progressive reveals), Slide 3 (THE PROBLEM badge + 4 company cards with red '3-5% spread' badges), Slide 6 (Hero Flowchart with portfolio companies, AFC Treasury container, currency accounts, activity boxes, output nodes including purple 'AFC Centralized USD Treasury'), Slide 9 (Matching Engine with 4 balance cards, 4 request cards with 'Approved' badges, summary stats), Slide 15 (Business Case with 3-5% red vs 0% green), Slide 20 (End Card with THCO, presentation title, 'Prepared for Africa Finance Corporation', 'Ayo Omomia').

Good use of data-testid attributes for all 20 slides and navigation elements (afc-slide-1 to afc-slide-20, afc-prev, afc-next, afc-grid)

JetBrains Mono monospace font correctly applied to slide counter and numeric values via .mono class
usePhase hook properly implements time-based progressive reveals with configurable intervals
useCount hook properly implements animated number counting with easing
SVG arrows (SvgArrow component) properly implement animated flowchart connections with stroke-dashoffset animation
Color palette correctly applied: bg #0B1120, teal #1D9E75, coral #D85A30, purple #6C5CE7, red #EF4444, green #4ADE80
Keyboard navigation properly implemented with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Space + F for fullscreen + Escape for grid
Touch swipe navigation implemented for mobile (60px threshold)
Grid overlay properly shows 20 thumbnails with current slide highlighted (.on class)
Progress bar at top shows proportional position with 300ms ease-out transition
All slides properly use animation delay helper function dl() for staggered reveals

context_for_next_testing_agent: AFC Treasury is a 20-slide institutional-grade animated presentation for Africa Finance Corporation. Routes: /proposals/afc-treasury (public, no auth), /proposals/preview/afc-treasury (preview). All data hardcoded in AFCTreasuryPresentation.jsx. Features: Dark navy #0B1120 background, teal #1D9E75 primary accent, coral #D85A30 secondary, purple #6C5CE7 for USD Treasury. Playfair Display serif headings, Inter sans-serif body, JetBrains Mono for numbers. Time-based progressive reveals via usePhase hook (Slide 1 needs 1.5s, Slide 6 needs 8s, Slide 9 needs 6s). SVG animated flowchart on Slide 6 with stroke-dashoffset animation. CSS-only animations via data-active attribute and animation classes (au=up, af=fade, al=left, as=scale). Full keyboard/touch navigation, progress bar at top, grid overlay on Escape. Key slides: S1 (title), S3 (problem with company cards), S6 (hero flowchart), S9 (matching engine), S15 (business case), S20 (end card).
